name: Ripio wBRL
oneLiner: WBRL is Ripio's wrapped Brazilian real stablecoin targeting 1 WBRL = 1 BRL, backed by BRL cash and local-currency instruments under Ripio's wFIAT issuance.
collateral: Brazilian-real cash and liquid local-currency instruments backing Ripio wBRL at a one Brazilian real target
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed local-currency stablecoin route targeting 1 WBRL = 1 BRL through Ripio's wFIAT issuance, redemption, and on/off-ramp infrastructure

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Ripio wBRL is centrally issued across multiple EVM chains; the public source confirms issuer-managed wFIAT mechanics but does not prove a holder-level blacklist path.

reserves.name: Brazilian-real cash and local-currency liquid instruments

notices.title: No per-token attestation located
notices.message: Ripio describes wFIAT local-currency backing, but no reliable public per-token reserve attestation was found for WBRL during this addition. Curated reserves remain conservative until source coverage improves.
